messages:
hana_marketing: Quick sync  we want to publish the release post Tuesday 15:00 PT. Need final canary window, canonical docs URL, HubSpot form, and bench image.

leo_engineering: Proposed rollout: 20m smoke -> 90m canary -> phased ramp. Canary start 2026-04-07T03:00:00Z. End condition: rollback if 5xx >1.5% for 10m or median latency increases >25%. Endpoints in canary: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings.

maya_docs: Docs preview here: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/releases/2026-apr. Changelog bullets ready. If merged canonical will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-apr. Note: model pinning is behind config flag `enable_model_pinning`  will add callout.

oliver_product: Merge docs before announce if possible. Also add a one-liner for Dedicated customers to contact CS for assisted rollouts.

sophia_sales: HubSpot form: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/apr-release. Tags: ["apr-release-2026","bench-webinar"]. Will auto-add `benchmark` tag for blog referrals.

hana_marketing: Draft announce copy: "Faster, cheaper inference: KV cache warmups, optional model pinning, and smarter batching. Read changelog + docs: <canonical link>. Webinar Wed 11:00 PT  register." Need bench PNG by EOD tomorrow.

leo_engineering: Perf will export the median-latency PNG and attach here by 2026-04-06 18:00 PT. Canary throttle 12rps -> ramp 48rps on success.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: smoke 2026-04-07T02:30:00Z; canary 2026-04-07T03:00:00Z -> 2026-04-07T04:30:00Z; ramp 2026-04-07T05:00:00Z. Rollback thresholds as posted.

hana_marketing: Final checklist to lock publish: 1) canonical docs URL (maya), 2) bench PNG (leo), 3) canary endpoints + thresholds (leo), 4) HubSpot form + tags (sophia). If green, target publish 2026-04-07 15:00 PT. Ping @marketing-alert if anything slips. Thanks all!
